method: Headed local Chrome 156 via DevTools browser automation; navigated searches and source pages, interacted with the Lenovo cookie dialog, extracted rendered page text and saved screenshots. No dedicated mouse-based computer-use tool was exposed in this session.
provenance_boundary: All six task offers, prices, laboratory results and retailer promises are synthetic research fixtures informed by these sources. They are not actual products, transactions, measurements or manufacturer guarantees.

sources.title: Our Laptop Performance Tests: Battery - RTINGS.com
sources.observed: Uses fixed 200 cd/m2 brightness, a controlled 22 C environment, and separate browsing/video/gaming workloads.
sources.design_use: Use a single stated protocol across the synthetic offers; do not mix vendor maximum-runtime claims into measured results.

sources.title: How does Notebookcheck test laptops and smartphones? A behind-the-scenes look into our review process - Notebookcheck Tech
sources.observed: Describes WLAN testing at approximately 150 cd/m2 and separate video playback with radios off; warns about measurement differences.
sources.design_use: Explain why test workload and settings must match before comparing battery hours.

sources.title: Best 14-inch laptops in 2025: 7 tested and reviewed picks | Laptop Mag
sources.observed: Discusses portability, workload, budget, memory, and battery trade-offs for 14-inch machines; its battery test uses Wi-Fi browsing at 150 nits.
sources.design_use: Use a commuting productivity persona and multiple defensible trade-offs. No ranking or review score is imported as ground truth.

sources.title: Acer Swift Go 14 (2024) Review - RTINGS.com
sources.observed: The accessible review identifies a tested configuration and discusses display variants, approximately 11 hours in light use, and keyboard comfort. Detailed measurements behind membership were not accessed.
sources.design_use: Keep configuration-specific evidence distinct from brand labels; include keyboard/display considerations. Do not copy locked measurements or user-comment allegations.

sources.title: The 7 Best Laptop Brands of 2026 - RTINGS.com
sources.observed: States that choice depends on needs and preferences, notes within-brand compromises, and explicitly lists brands alphabetically rather than by rank.
sources.design_use: Do not use a brand-list position as a quality ranking or treat all products from one company as equivalent.

sources.title: Product - Lenovo PSREF
sources.observed: ThinkPad T14s Gen 6 AMD overview lists up to 64 GB soldered memory, starting weight 1.25 kg, and multiple display/configuration options.
sources.design_use: State delivered RAM, upgrade limitations, display type, and exact offer weight. These real family specifications are not assigned to other brands.

sources.title: CoreBook Air Copilot+ PC Laptop Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 226V – CHUWI Global Store
sources.observed: CoreBook Air 226V listing advertises 16 GB/512 GB, approximately 1.2 kg, 55 Wh, and up to 15 hours. Currency and promotions are regional/dynamic.
sources.design_use: Include CHUWI as a real laptop manufacturer without prelabelling its quality. Use synthetic fixed all-in prices instead of volatile promotional prices.

sources.title: Returns | Dell USA
sources.observed: US direct-purchase return policy describes an eligible 30-day invoice-based window, exclusions and fees, and directs indirect purchasers to their retailer policy.
sources.design_use: Specify merchant of record, return-window start, costs, and what agreement applies.

sources.title: Warranty Policy – CHUWI Global Store
sources.observed: The store policy states a 1-year warranty and customer-paid shipping to its Hong Kong or Germany service centers, with repaired devices returned without additional shipping charges.
sources.design_use: Real service terms can legitimately differ. The task instead declares a separate retailer package; its 24 months/prepaid shipping/loaner are synthetic, not CHUWI policy.

limitations: Google returned a traffic challenge on the second query; subsequent discovery used Bing and direct source navigation. No challenge was bypassed.
ASUS product-page navigation failed with ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED and the old CHUWI CoreBook X store URL returned 404; neither was used as substantive product evidence.
RTINGS membership-only detailed results were not accessed; only available page text and conclusions were used.
Browser captures are local ignored research artifacts, not agent workspace materials or Judge inputs.
